specification: Azure tenancy support: technical support, incident management, service requests, knowledge transfer and reporting (II.2.4)

finding.zh: 真实获授公告可证明NRS向Storm ID采购支持服务；不能据此把Microsoft写成直接合同相对方。
finding.en: The award names NRS and Storm ID for support, not Microsoft as the direct contractor.
finding.ko: 낙찰 공고의 지원 계약 당사자는 NRS와 Storm ID이며 Microsoft를 직접 계약자로 입증하지 않습니다.

limitation.zh: 未附合同；签约日不是交付日。缺验收日期与违约条款，不证明供应商切断权或Azure全部依赖。
limitation.en: No attached contract; conclusion is not delivery. Acceptance and default terms are missing; cut-off rights remain unproven.
limitation.ko: 계약 첨부 없음. 체결일은 인도일이 아니며 검수일·채무불이행 조항·차단 권한은 미확인.
